title: Foster Lewis and Dude's band and the player Yalla
summary: He lists the first band he played with and says little of Yalla.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah I spoke about them on the earlier reel. I used to play with them. The first band I played with was Foster Lewis and Dude. Because Roussel, or Bud Roussel was playing bass with them. That was the first band I would play with.
Who was in that band? I didn't get that straight.
I had Bud Roussel, Farstown, Dude, Yalla, Lil' Dad. Piano player? I think Lil' Arthur was on saxophone or clarinet. Lil' who?
Lil' slim fella, something on all the joys but he's kind of got a funny eye. Well he ain't played in a long time now.
Is that the guy that has a restaurant down on San Bernard? No.
Not Arthur Durbin? No. Well who was this Yalla?
That's what I wanted to ask you about.

Yalla was kind of a Heaviseth Wright fella. I don't know why they gave him that name of Yalla or something. Y'all ears you know. Well I played with him, he played with Foster Lewis a few times. He wasn't no record-study man. I remember him being with the band several times.
